meta.title: AI Relationship Court
meta.description: Two partners, one disagreement, a structured AI panel, and a verdict.

login.title: Please state your name.
login.subtitle: Sign in so the court knows who is testifying.
login.failed: Sign-in didn't go through. Please try again.

new.title: Create your couple
new.body: You'll be Partner A. We'll give you a private invite link to send to your partner. Once they join, you can file your first case.

invite.title: Invite your partner
invite.body: Send this link to your partner. It works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.expired: Your previous invite has expired or been used.

join.label: Summons
join.title: You've been invited
join.invalid: That invite link is invalid, already used, or expired. Ask your partner for a new one.
join.already: You're already part of a couple.
join.body: {inviter} has invited you to join their court as Partner B.

docket.title: Your docket
docket.noneBody: Every case needs two parties. Create your couple, then invite your partner.
docket.waitingPartner: Waiting for your partner to join.
docket.noCases: No cases yet. File your first one.

history.label: Registry
history.title: Verdicts
history.body: Past cases and insights arrive in Phase 8.

newCase.label: Docket
newCase.title: File a case
newCase.needCouple: A case needs both partners. Finish setting up your couple first.
newCase.alreadyOpen: You already have an open case: {title}. Finish it before filing another.
newCase.intro: Describe what the case is about. The court will name it, then both partners tell their side, privately.
newCase.fieldHint: A sentence or two of neutral background. The court will give the case a title — keep your side of the story for your testimony.
newCase.placeholder: We argued because one of us cancelled dinner plans at the last minute.
newCase.submitting: The clerk is naming your case…

casePage.testimonyIntro: Tell the court what happened, in your own words. {partner} can't see this until the verdict.
casePage.waitingTestimony: Your testimony is filed. The court will move on as soon as your partner has given theirs. This page updates by itself.
casePage.analysingTitle: The court is analysing the case
casePage.analysingBody: Both testimonies are in. The court is reading them and preparing your follow-up questions — this can take up to a minute. This page updates by itself.
casePage.followUpTitle: The court has a few questions
casePage.followUpIntro: Having read both accounts, the court needs a little more from you. This is the only round of questions.
casePage.questionsNotReady: Your questions aren't ready yet. Try refreshing.
casePage.waitingAnswersBody: Your answers are in. The court will move on as soon as your partner has answered theirs. This page updates by itself.
casePage.panelBody: All the evidence is in. The verdict arrives in the next phase of the build.
casePage.stillBuilding: This part of the court is still being built.

testimony.causesLegend: What do you think caused it?
testimony.partnerWrong: What do you think your partner did wrong?
testimony.needsLegend: What did you want from your partner?
testimony.finalNote: Your testimony is final once submitted and stays private until the verdict.
testimony.pickHint: Pick at least one option for feelings, cause and what you needed to continue.

followUp.question: Q{n}
followUp.note: You only get one round of follow-up questions. Your answers stay private until the verdict.

caseErrors.case_already_open: Your couple already has an open case. Finish it before filing another.
caseErrors.no_active_couple: You need a couple with both partners before filing a case.
caseErrors.already_testified: You've already given your testimony for this case.
caseErrors.not_allowed: You can't submit testimony for this case right now.
caseErrors.already_answered: You've already answered the follow-up questions for this case.
caseErrors.invalid: Please check your answers — some fields are missing, too short or too long.
caseErrors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

inviteErrors.invite_invalid: That invite link doesn't look right.
inviteErrors.invite_used: That invite has already been used.
inviteErrors.invite_expired: That invite has expired. Ask your partner for a new one.
inviteErrors.invite_own: You can't join your own invite — send it to your partner.
inviteErrors.already_in_couple: You're already part of a couple.
inviteErrors.no_pending_couple: You don't have a couple waiting for a partner.
inviteErrors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

aiErrors.invalid_output: The court couldn't finish reading the case. Please try again.
aiErrors.unavailable: The court's AI is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
aiErrors.not_configured: The court's AI isn't set up yet. Add the DashScope key, then try again.

verdict.heading: The court's verdict
verdict.estimated: Estimated responsibility for this specific conflict.
verdict.tiebreakJury: Too close to call, so the Jury broke the tie.
verdict.tiebreakFallback: Too close to call, so the rest of the panel broke the tie.
verdict.translating: Translating this into your language… showing English for now.
verdict.translationFailed: We couldn't translate this yet, so it's shown in English.
verdict.pending: The verdict is ready, but its text isn't available yet. Try refreshing.
